Question: Using NHANES from 2009 to 2016 we will run a logistic regression where the predictor is neutrophil count / lymphocyte count, categorize in quartiles (%) Q1: ≤25, Q2: >25 and ≤50, Q3: >50 and ≤75, Q4: >75 and adjust for age, sex, race. Outcome is depression which is based on the total score from the nine questions "have little interest in doing things", "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless", "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much", "feeling tired or having little energy", "poor appetite or overeating", "feeling bad about yourself", "trouble concentrating on things", "moving or speaking slowly or too fast", "thought you would be better off dead", calculated where each question has value of Not at all (0), Several days (1), More than half the days (2), Nearly every day (3), if value is null assign (0), and the total score >=10 was defined as clinically relevant depression and else was not. We will include participants who are equal or more than 18 years and diabetic patients where diabetes is defined as diabetes history or subjects taking antidiabetic medications or subjects taking insulin now.  We will exclude participants who had missing data on depression questionnaires and NLR that requires neutrophil count and lymphocyte count. We will exclude participants who are missing all of three variables: doctor told you have diabetes, take diabetic pills to lower blood sugar, taking insulin now.

Analysis Type: logistic regression

Dataset: NHANES

Period of Interest: 2009-2016

Inclusion Criteria:
- age >= 18
- (doctor told you have diabetes = Yes OR take diabetic pills to lower blood sugar = Yes OR taking insulin now = Yes)

Exclusion Criteria:
- missing "have little interest in doing things" OR missing "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless" OR missing "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much" OR missing "feeling tired or having little energy" OR missing "poor appetite or overeating" OR missing "feeling bad about yourself" OR missing "trouble concentrating on things" OR missing "moving or speaking slowly or too fast" OR missing "thought you would be better off dead"
- missing neutrophil count OR missing lymphocyte count
- missing "doctor told you have diabetes" AND missing "take diabetic pills to lower blood sugar" AND missing "taking insulin now"

Covariates:
- age
- sex
- race

Predictor:
- neutrophil count / lymphocyte count categorized into quartiles (%):
  Q1: ≤25
  Q2: >25 and ≤50
  Q3: >50 and ≤75
  Q4: >75

Outcome:
- depression = 1 if total score >= 10; 0 otherwise
  total score calculated as the sum of the scores from the following nine questions:
  - "have little interest in doing things"
  - "feeling down, depressed, or hopeless"
  - "trouble sleeping or sleeping too much"
  - "feeling tired or having little energy"
  - "poor appetite or overeating"
  - "feeling bad about yourself"
  - "trouble concentrating on things"
  - "moving or speaking slowly or too fast"
  - "thought you would be better off dead"
  Each question is scored as:
  - Not at all: 0
  - Several days: 1
  - More than half the days: 2
  - Nearly every day: 3
  If a question's value is null, assign 0.

-- ========== STEP 1: Inclusion ==========

-- STEP 1.1: Include participants who are equal or more than 18 years
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step1 AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM final_master_table
WHERE "age_in_years_at_screening" >= 18;

-- STEP 1.2: Derive diabetes status for the inclusion criteria
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes_status AS
SELECT
  f."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" = 'Yes'
      OR f."take_diabetic_pills_to_lower_blood_sugar" = 'Yes'
      OR f."taking_insulin_now" = 'Yes'
    THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS "diabetes_status"
FROM final_master_table f
JOIN temp_inclusion_step1 i ON f."respondent_sequence_number" = i."respondent_sequence_number";

-- STEP 1.3: From the above group, include only diabetic patients
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_inclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step1 i
JOIN temp_diabetes_status ds ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = ds."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE ds."diabetes_status" = TRUE;

-- ========== STEP 2: Exclusions ==========

-- STEP 2.1: Derive phq9_missing status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_phq9_missing_status AS
SELECT
  f."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."have_little_interest_in_doing_things" IS NULL
      OR f."feeling_down_depressed_or_hopeless" IS NULL
      OR f."trouble_sleeping_or_sleeping_too_much" IS NULL
      OR f."feeling_tired_or_having_little_energy" IS NULL
      OR f."poor_appetite_or_overeating" IS NULL
      OR f."feeling_bad_about_yourself" IS NULL
      OR f."trouble_concentrating_on_things" IS NULL
      OR f."moving_or_speaking_slowly_or_too_fast" IS NULL
      OR f."thought_you_would_be_better_off_dead" IS NULL
    THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS "phq9_missing"
FROM final_master_table f
JOIN temp_inclusion_step2 i ON f."respondent_sequence_number" = i."respondent_sequence_number";

-- STEP 2.2: Exclude participants who had missing data on depression questionnaires
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step1 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_inclusion_step2 i
JOIN temp_phq9_missing_status pms ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = pms."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE pms."phq9_missing" = FALSE;

-- STEP 2.3: Derive blood_count_missing status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_blood_count_missing_status AS
SELECT
  f."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."segmented_neutrophils_num_1000_cell_ul" IS NULL
      OR f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" IS NULL
    THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS "blood_count_missing"
FROM final_master_table f
JOIN temp_exclusion_step1 i ON f."respondent_sequence_number" = i."respondent_sequence_number";

-- STEP 2.4: Exclude participants who had missing data on NLR components
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step2 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step1 i
JOIN temp_blood_count_missing_status bcms ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = bcms."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE bcms."blood_count_missing" = FALSE;

-- STEP 2.5: Derive diabetes_info_missing status
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_diabetes_info_missing_status AS
SELECT
  f."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN f."doctor_told_you_have_diabetes" IS NULL
      AND f."take_diabetic_pills_to_lower_blood_sugar" IS NULL
      AND f."taking_insulin_now" IS NULL
    THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS "diabetes_info_missing"
FROM final_master_table f
JOIN temp_exclusion_step2 i ON f."respondent_sequence_number" = i."respondent_sequence_number";

-- STEP 2.6: Exclude participants who are missing all three diabetes variables
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_exclusion_step3 AS
SELECT i."respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step2 i
JOIN temp_diabetes_info_missing_status dims ON i."respondent_sequence_number" = dims."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE dims."diabetes_info_missing" = FALSE;

-- ========== STEP 3: Cohort ==========

-- The final temp table in the exclusion sequence becomes temp_cohort.
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_cohort AS
SELECT "respondent_sequence_number"
FROM temp_exclusion_step3;

-- 4.4 Neutrophil Lymphocyte Ratio (Predictor)
-- Calculate raw neutrophil lymphocyte ratio
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_nlr_raw AS
SELECT
  c."respondent_sequence_number",
  (f."segmented_neutrophils_num_1000_cell_ul" / f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul") AS "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_raw"
FROM temp_cohort c
JOIN final_master_table f ON c."respondent_sequence_number" = f."respondent_sequence_number"
WHERE f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" IS NOT NULL AND f."lymphocyte_number_1000_cells_ul" != 0; -- Avoid division by zero

-- Compute quartile cutoffs for neutrophil lymphocyte ratio within cohort
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_nlr_cutoffs AS
SELECT
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_raw") AS q1,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_raw") AS q2,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_raw") AS q3
FROM temp_nlr_raw;

-- Assign neutrophil lymphocyte ratio quartile group
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio AS
SELECT
  n."respondent_sequence_number",
  CASE
    WHEN n."neutrophil_lymphocyte_ratio_raw" IS NULL THEN NULL

    }
